 News Nov 19, 2026 11:48 by Fergus Morgan Edinburgh International Festival director Nicola Benedetti. Photo: Jassy Earl Next year’s Edinburgh International Festival will be extended into early September to mark the organisation’s 80th anniversary, with its director Nicola Benedetti set to stay in post for two more years Read this article for  free !
